No published image shows the errata text; [[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB3-76-Luke_Skywalker_Rebel_Scout-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “[Pilot] 2. Deploys -2 to a forest. Luke's weapon destiny draws are +1. At same site, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon. During opponent's draw phase, if alone on Endor, may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to attrition < 5.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 11). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “His weapon destiny draws” for “Luke’s weapon destiny draws” (it writes the pilot icon out as “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots.”, which is notation only): “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 to a forest. His weapon destiny draws are +1. At same site, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon. During opponent's draw phase, if alone on Endor, may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to attrition < 5.”<ref name="cl-1230_75-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205219/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
